title: Analytic: plane-wave scattering by a small dielectric sphere, closed TFSF box (3D FDTD, Mie)
description:
A plane-wave pulse (+z, E along x, amplitude 1 V/m, gaussian at 1 um, bandwidth 0.5) fills a closed TFSF box (0.15-0.35 um on every axis) around a dielectric sphere (eps = 4, r = 60 nm = 12 cells, centred on a cell corner) in a 0.5 um vacuum cube with CPML on all six faces (em_fdtd_3d, 5 nm cells, ~10 s). Outside the box only the scattered field remains: a flux box at 0.1-0.4 um gives the scattered power, the same box feeds two near-to-far transforms (x-z and y-z cuts).
Analytic (Mie, dipole terms; m = 2, size parameter x = 2 pi r / lambda): Q_sca = sigma / (pi r^2) = (6 / x^2) (|a1|^2 + |b1|^2) with a1, b1 from the Riccati-Bessel functions psi1(z) = sin z / z - cos z, chi1(z) = cos z / z + sin z in closed form: |a1|^2 = 1 / (1 + (M_a / N_a)^2), N_a = m psi1(mx) psi1'(x) - psi1(x) psi1'(mx), M_a = m psi1(mx) chi1'(x) - chi1(x) psi1'(mx), and b1 alike with m moved to the other term; a2 (~1e-4 of Q) is left out. Q_sca(1 um) = 0.01422 (Rayleigh (8/3) x^4 ((m^2 - 1)/(m^2 + 2))^2 = 0.01347, i.e. the a1 size correction is +5.6 %); power_per_cw = Q_sca pi r^2 A^2 / (2 eta0).
Derived values tab: Q_sca_1000 = power_per_cw / (I_inc pi r^2) at 1 um vs the Mie value.
Spectra tab: em.scattered quantity power_per_cw vs the dashed Mie spectrum (~1 / lambda^4) over 0.8-1.3 um.
Far field tab (peak-normalised, angles from +x toward +z, resp. from +y toward +z; cos(theta) = sin(angle) with theta from the propagation axis +z): em.far_xz vs (sin(angle) + B + G cos 2 theta)^2 (the sin^2 of the x dipole, nulls along x) and em.far_yz vs (1 + (B + G) sin(angle))^2, B = b1 / a1 = x^2 (m^2 + 2) / 30, G = (5/3) a2 / a1 = x^2 (m^2 + 2) / (6 (2 m^2 + 3)) (small-x forms): the magnetic dipole and the electric quadrupole make the y-z pattern ~18 % stronger forward than backward at 1 um, not flat.
Expected agreement: a few % in Q_sca with subpixel smoothing on (solver_defaults; the 3D averaging sees the sphere as one-cell disks, so normals near the poles are approximate); staircased with the plain face-mean permittivity Q_sca came out 8.5 % high at every wavelength (first-order in dx); ~1 % of the peak in the patterns.
